title: These highlights do not include all the information needed to use FLUOXETINE TABLETS safely and effectively. See full prescribing information for FLUOXETINE TABLETS. FLUOXETINE tablets, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 1987

sections.contraindications: When using fluoxetine and olanzapine in combination, also refer to the Contraindications section of the package insert for Symbyax ®.
sections.warnings_and_precautions: When using fluoxetine and olanzapine in combination, also refer to the Warnings and Precautions section of the package insert for Symbyax ® .
sections.adverse_reactions: When using fluoxetine and olanzapine in combination, also refer to the Adverse Reactions section of the package insert for Symbyax ®.
sections.drug_interactions: As with all drugs, the potential for interaction by a variety of mechanisms (e.g., pharmacodynamic, pharmacokinetic drug inhibition or enhancement, etc.) is a possibility.
sections.boxed_warning: Fluoxetine Tablets, USP are available containing fluoxetine hydrochloride, USP equivalent to 10 mg of fluoxetine. Fluoxetine Tablets USP, 20 mg are white, film-coated, oval shaped biconvex, scored (functional) tablets debossed with “2” on the left of the score and “0” on the right of the score on one side of the tablet and “FL” on the other side. They are available as follows: NDC: 70518-4429-00 PACKAGING: 30 in 1 BLISTER PACK Store at 20° to 25°C (68° to 77°F). [See USP Controlled Room Temperature.] Protect from light. Dispense in a tight, light-resistant container as defined in the USP using a child-resistant closure.
